jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Opal Security:

At Opal, we’re building modern identity governance for the AI era—intelligent access management that empowers enterprises to move fast while staying secure. Our mission is to bring clarity, control, and confidence to complex enterprise environments, helping teams govern access without slowing down innovation.



The Role:

Identity is having a moment. Every company is deploying agents, spinning up service accounts, and realizing their IAM stack can't keep up. We're building AI-native security that scales with this chaos and companies like Databricks, Cloudflare, and Figma are betting on us to get it right.



You will own Opal's product direction and execution. You'll work directly with security and engineering teams at Fortune 500s and startups alike, understand their messy reality, and determine our position as a leader in IAM. You’ll report directly into our CPO and work hand in hand with our engineering team.



Please note: We've built a team that works exceptionally well together and has fun doing so. We're looking to bring on new teammates who will both add to and grow with what we're building 🙂



Your Responsibilities:

 - Own product strategy from insight to execution. Own what we build and where we expand, work directly with customers to validate direction, partner with engineering on technical strategy, and ensure our roadmap positions us to win in IAM.

 - Architect our platform to unify human and non-human identity governance across hybrid environments by making sense of on-prem AD, cloud IAM, SaaS apps, and AI agents.

 - Lead our evolution from fast and flexible to enterprise-grade at scale without losing what developers love about us.

 - Drive category creation and position Opal as the authorization intelligence layer, not just another point solution in a crowded IAM landscape.

 - Define the future for Opal and for Identity
   
   

Our Ideal Candidate Loves to:

 - Think strategically: you can look at market dynamics, customer feedback, and technical constraints to determine the right direction forward.

 - Build platforms, not just features: you understand API strategy, developer experience, and how to create extensible systems that others build on.

 - Thrive in undefined spaces: you get energized by ambiguous problems where there's no playbook. You'd rather figure out what to build than refine an existing roadmap.

 - Work across the stack: you're comfortable talking technical architecture with engineers, doing the boring admin work, and owning business outcomes with customers.

 - Most importantly - shape a category: you're excited about defining what AI-native IAM means and building the product that becomes the standard.
   
   

What You Bring:

 - 6+ years in product management, owning a highly technical product or solution in the security space

 - Track record building 1-to-n products and scaling them

 - Ability to drive high performant engineering output

 - Either a degree in computer science or you categorize yourself as a pseudo/honorary engineer

jobs.title: Product Marketing & Content Associate
jobs.description:
About Opal Security:

The best security and engineering teams use Opal Security, the AI-native access platform, for real-time visibility, policy-as-code, and control over every identity, from employees to service accounts to AI agents. Companies like Databricks, Notion, CoreWeave, and Superhuman rely on Opal. Based in San Francisco, we've raised $59M from Greylock, Battery Ventures, and SVCI, and were named to Notable Capital's Rising in Cyber 2026 list by 150 leading CISOs. Our leadership brings deep security pedigree: CEO Howard Ting (previously CEO of Cyberhaven, CMO at Nutanix), CPO Sameer Mehta (Veza, Citrix), and CTO Alex Pien (Meta), among others who've built category-defining products.



The Role:

Governing who can access what, and revoking it the moment it's no longer needed, is one of the hardest problems in enterprise security, and it starts with people. Now AI agents are entering the same systems at machine speed, inheriting the same over-scoped access, and the problem is compounding fast. Opal is the control plane for all of it, and telling that story is what this role is about. We're hiring a Product Marketing & Content Associate to amplify Opal’s voice, using AI and automation to give one person the reach of a much larger team. About two-thirds is content and channels you'll own outright; the rest supports senior functions like PR, analyst relations, and sales enablement. You'll report into the Head of Product & Solutions Marketing, and the ideal candidate is a strong writer who is fluent with AI tools.



 - Build the AI-powered content engine, including automations and workflows

 - Own Opal's social presence end to end: daily posts, real-time engagement, and inventive campaigns (polls, bracket-style games) that make a technical category feel alive

 - Create short-form video for LinkedIn, X, and YouTube, product clips, C-suite cuts, event moments, with a creator's instinct for hooks and platform-native formats

 - Translate what's new into stories, turning product updates and launches into blogs, posts, and screen recording walkthroughs alongside PM and Engineering

 - Shape thought leadership with our marketing leadership and C-suite, ghostwriting and producing the ideas that position Opal at the front of a new category

 - Run the monthly newsletter start to finish, plus web updates and copy, including SEO/AEO

 - Drive integration and partnership announcements, webinar and CTA promotion, and event recaps

 - Support PR: contributed articles (about one per month) and pitches for launches and news moments

 - Support customer story capture (video and written) and analyst relations outreach and management

 - Help manage our podcast, newsletter sponsorships, and influencer relationships

 - Lead one-pagers, click-through demos, and other sales plays (including competitive), and support the first-call deck
   
   

FYI - we are building Opal together, in person. This role is 3+ days in office in downtown San Francisco :)

 

You Might Be a Fit If You:

 - Are a genuinely strong writer who can adapt voice: yours and the brand's

 - Can create short-form video that earns attention, comfortable on camera or behind it, with instinct for what works on each platform

 - Have real AI fluency: you use AI tools daily and reach for automation rather than grinding through things manually

 - Are comfortable with an always-on pace and concurrent deliverable
   
   

Tools We Use:

We're always adding to this as new AI-native tools prove themselves. Fluency with the category matters more than any one name below.

 - Design and demos: Figma, Arcade, Framer

 - Screen recording and video: Screen Studio, Descript, CapCut

 - AI and automation: Claude, Claude Code, Perplexity

 - Meetings and content ops: Granola, Notion

 - Video and podcast editing: Descript
